Claro Brasil (beOn Claro) launched GPU-as-a-Service in partnership with NVIDIA, becoming NVIDIA's first authorized NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) in Latin America; sells fractional GPU capacity in reals for AI/LLM training and inference to startups, SMEs and government. [NVIDIA]
deployments_detail.value: R$1 billion invested in Claro Cloud platform (prior year); first NVIDIA NCP in Latin America

In gradual production rollout. [Large Language Models (vendor unnamed)]

TelcelBot, an AI-powered intelligent virtual assistant/chatbot for customer self-service (balance checks, bill payment, recharges, plan queries), available 24/7 on Telcel.com, the Mi Telcel app, and WhatsApp. [none]

Claro Empresas (Brasil) sells 'atendimento inteligente' — an intelligent customer-service solution using chatbots and virtual assistants that answer queries 24/7 across text, voice and image, marketed as a B2B professional service. [none]

[Google (Gemini / Google AI Pro, Veo 3)]
